احتمين (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَيْنَ (iḥtamayna) /iħ.ta.maj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اُحْتُمِينَ (uḥtumīna) /uħ.tu.miː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اِحْتَمِينَ (iḥtamīna) /iħ.ta.miː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
